knowledge:
- key_parameters: ometiff=Path to the OME-TIFF file from the GeoMx instrument ;; annots=Lab worksheet or annotation file/object ;; slideName=Name of the slide to extract ;; image=Logical; whether to load the image immediately (default FALSE, can be added later) ;; outline=Logical; if TRUE, only ROI outline points are saved to save memory/time (must be FALSE if any ROIs are segmented) ;; res=Resolution level to extract from the pyramidal OME-TIFF (1 is largest/highest resolution, higher numbers are smaller; res 4-6 recommended, check with checkValidRes) ;; colorBy=Variable/annotation to color the ROIs by (e.g., gene expression, segment) ;; hiRes=Logical; if TRUE, uses high-resolution coordinates (uses fill), if FALSE, uses low-resolution (uses color) ;; sampsOnly=Logical; in cropSamples, if TRUE, hides other ROIs within the cropped region ;; buffer=Percentage of the final image size to add to each edge when cropping
- alternatives: GeomxTools/GeoMxWorkflows=Used for upstream GeoMx data analysis and creating GeomxSet objects containing gene expression data
- when_to_use: When visualizing NanoString GeoMx experiments, specifically to reconstruct free-handed ROI selections and immunofluorescent-guided segmentations on top of the original OME-TIFF scan
- pitfalls: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space=Occurs during readSpatialOverlay(). Fix by restarting R and setting options(java.parameters = "-Xmx4g") before loading any libraries (especially RBioFormats) ;; java.lang.NegativeArraySizeException=Occurs when the image resolution (res) is too high (too large) for the system. Fix by increasing the res value (extracting a smaller image layer) ;; cache resources exhausted @ error/cache.c/OpenPixelCache/4095=Occurs due to memory limits in the magick package configuration. Fix by adjusting the magick config limits.

workflows.name: spatial_overlay_visualization
workflows.intent: Reconstruct ROI overlays from GeoMx OME-TIFF and lab worksheets, add gene expression or segment annotations, manipulate the image (crop/flip/recolor), and plot the overlay.
input: scan_image.ome.tiff (OME-TIFF image file from GeoMx instrument)
geomx_data.rds (GeomxSet object containing gene expression data)
workflows.stages: 1. Set Java memory parameters and load libraries ;; 2. Read spatial overlay data using readSpatialOverlay ;; 3. Add plotting factors (annotations or gene expression) using addPlottingFactor ;; 4. Add the OME-TIFF image at a specific resolution using addImageOmeTiff ;; 5. Manipulate the image/coordinates (e.g., flipY, cropTissue, cropSamples) ;; 6. Customize image coloring (optional) using add4ChannelImage, changeImageColoring, changeColoringIntensity, and recolor ;; 7. Plot the spatial overlay using plotSpatialOverlay and optionally add a fluorophore legend using fluorLegend
workflows.code:
options(java.parameters = "-Xmx4g")
library(RBioFormats)
library(SpatialOmicsOverlay)
library(GeomxTools)

tifFile <- downloadMouseBrainImage()
muBrainLW <- system.file("extdata", "muBrain_LabWorksheet.txt", package = "SpatialOmicsOverlay")
muBrain <- readSpatialOverlay(ometiff = tifFile, annots = muBrainLW, slideName = "D5761 (3)", image = FALSE, saveFile = FALSE, outline = FALSE)

muBrainAnnots <- readLabWorksheet(lw = muBrainLW, slideName = "D5761 (3)")
muBrainGeomxSet <- readRDS(unzip(system.file("extdata", "muBrain_GxT.zip", package = "SpatialOmicsOverlay")))
muBrain <- addPlottingFactor(overlay = muBrain, annots = muBrainAnnots, plottingFactor = "segment")
muBrain <- addPlottingFactor(overlay = muBrain, annots = muBrainGeomxSet, plottingFactor = "Calm1")
muBrain <- addPlottingFactor(overlay = muBrain, annots = 1:length(sampNames(muBrain)), plottingFactor = "ROILabel")

checkValidRes(ometiff = tifFile)
res <- 8
muBrain <- addImageOmeTiff(overlay = muBrain, ometiff = tifFile, res = res)
showImage(muBrain)

plotSpatialOverlay(overlay = muBrain, colorBy = "segment", corner = "topcenter", scaleBarWidth = 0.5, textDistance = 130, scaleBarColor = "cyan")

plotSpatialOverlay(overlay = muBrain, colorBy = "segment", corner = "topcenter", scaleBarWidth = 0.5, textDistance = 130, scaleBarColor = "cyan", fluorLegend = TRUE)

library(cowplot)
gp <- plotSpatialOverlay(overlay = muBrain, colorBy = "segment", corner = "bottomright")
legend <- fluorLegend(muBrain, nrow = 2, textSize = 4, boxColor = "grey85", alpha = 0.3)
cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_plot(gp) + cowplot::draw_plot(legend, scale = 0.105, x = 0.1, y = -0.25)

muBrain <- flipY(muBrain)
plotSpatialOverlay(overlay = muBrain, colorBy = "segment", scaleBar = FALSE)
plotSpatialOverlay(overlay = flipX(muBrain), colorBy = "segment", scaleBar = FALSE)

muBrain <- cropTissue(overlay = muBrain, buffer = 0.05)
plotSpatialOverlay(overlay = muBrain, colorBy = "ROILabel", legend = FALSE, scaleBar = FALSE)+ viridis::scale_fill_viridis(option = "C")

samps <- muBrainAnnots$Sample_ID[muBrainAnnots$segment == "Full ROI" & muBrainAnnots$slide.name == slideName(muBrain)]
muBrainCrop <- cropSamples(overlay = muBrain, sampleIDs = samps, sampsOnly = TRUE)
plotSpatialOverlay(overlay = muBrainCrop, colorBy = "Calm1", scaleBar = TRUE, corner = "bottomleft", textDistance = 5)+ ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = "grey", high = "red", mid = "yellow", midpoint = 2500)

muBrainCrop <- cropSamples(overlay = muBrain, sampleIDs = samps, sampsOnly = FALSE)
plotSpatialOverlay(overlay = muBrainCrop, colorBy = "segment", scaleBar = TRUE, corner = "bottomleft", textDistance = 5)

chan4 <- add4ChannelImage(overlay = muBrain)
fluor(chan4)
chan4 <- changeImageColoring(overlay = chan4, color = "#32a8a4", dye = "FITC")
chan4 <- changeImageColoring(overlay = chan4, color = "magenta", dye = "Alexa 647")
chan4 <- changeColoringIntensity(overlay = chan4, minInten = 500, maxInten = 10000, dye = "Cy5")
fluor(chan4)
chan4 <- recolor(chan4)
showImage(chan4)
